control.pageHead:
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<style>

html, body { margin:0; }
#ee_divRoot { position:relative !important; inset:auto !important; width:100% !important; height:auto !important; min-height:100dvh; overflow:visible !important; background:#f7f7fc; }
#ee_divRoot, #ee_divRoot * { box-sizing:border-box; }
#ee_divRoot a { color:#46368b; text-underline-offset:.16em; }
#ee_divRoot a:focus-visible, #ee_divRoot [role=button]:focus-visible, #ee_divRoot input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #7c63d2; outline-offset:2px; }
#ee_divRoot h1,#ee_divRoot h2,#ee_divRoot h3,#ee_divRoot p,#ee_divRoot pre { margin:0; }
#ee_divRoot h1 { font:750 clamp(28px,5vw,48px)/1.12 system-ui,sans-serif; }
#ee_divRoot h2 { font:720 clamp(21px,3vw,30px)/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif; }
#ee_divRoot h3 { font:700 19px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif; }
#ee_divRoot pre { white-space:pre-wrap; overflow-wrap:anywhere; font:14px/1.55 ui-monospace,monospace; }
#ee_divRoot code { overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] {
position:relative !important; inset:auto !important; width:100% !important; height:auto !important; overflow:visible !important;
}
:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] > div:has(> table) { position:relative !important; inset:auto !important; height:auto !important; width:100% !important; overflow:visible !important; }
:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] > div > table { position:relative !important; inset:auto !important; height:auto !important; width:100% !important; white-space:normal !important; border-collapse:collapse; }
:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] td { padding:0; line-height:1.55; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
#ee_epageStudio,
#ee_home,
#ee_features,
#ee_examples,
#ee_tutorials,
#ee_support,
#ee_blog,
#ee_contactSupport,
#ee_websiteUse,
#ee_privacy,
#ee_copyright { margin-block:6px; }
#ee_logo256 { background-position:center; background-repeat:no-repeat; background-size:contain; border-radius:5px; }
#ee_siteheader { background:white !important; }
#ee_brand { max-width:1160px; margin:auto; padding:8px 16px; display:flex !important; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
#ee_logo256 { width:44px !important; height:44px !important; flex:none; }
#ee_primarynavigation { display:flex !important; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
#ee_home,
#ee_features,
#ee_examples,
#ee_tutorials,
#ee_support,
#ee_blog { width:auto !important; min-height:44px; display:flex !important; align-items:center; padding:0 12px; margin:0; }
#ee_sitefooter { display:flex !important; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:0 16px; padding:4px 12px; }
#ee_epageStudio,
#ee_contactSupport,
#ee_websiteUse,
#ee_privacy,
#ee_copyright { width:auto !important; }
#ee_contentframe { min-height:0; height:100% !important; }
#ee_logo256 { max-width:44px; aspect-ratio:44/44; background-image:url(data:image/png;base64,); } #ee_logo256 > img { display:none !important; }
#ee_home a { color:#fff; }
#ee_features a { color:#fff; }
#ee_examples a { color:#fff; }
#ee_tutorials a { color:#fff; }
#ee_support a { color:#fff; }
#ee_blog a { color:#fff; }
#ee_divRoot { display:grid !important; grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; height:100dvh !important; }
#ee_contentframe iframe { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; border:0; }
#ee_primarynavigation a { color:white; text-decoration:none; padding-block:10px; display:inline-block; }
#ee_primarynavigation a:hover, #ee_primarynavigation a[aria-current=page] { text-decoration:underline; }</style>
